review_candidates.description: Company Description At UniPower, we provide advanced power quality and engineering solutions backed by over 26 years of experience. We support organizations across multiple sectors by protecting critical operations, improving energy efficiency, and ensuring reliable, uninterrupted performance. Our teams work through a comprehensive approach that spans consultancy, design, implementation, and ongoing support. UniPower focuses on reducing operational risk, enabling business continuity, and delivering long-term value through engineering excellence and dependable power solutions. Professionals joining UniPower can expect to contribute to technically challenging projects that have a direct impact on mission-critical infrastructure. Role Description The Electrical Data Center & Critical Power Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Giza. This role is responsible for designing, reviewing, and optimizing electrical infrastructure for data centers and other critical facilities, including power distribution systems, backup power solutions, and protection schemes. Day-to-day tasks include performing load analysis and power system calculations, preparing technical drawings and documentation, and ensuring compliance with relevant codes, standards, and safety regulations. The engineer collaborates with cross-functional teams to support system installation, commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting, and provides technical guidance during implementation and maintenance activities. The role also involves participating in client meetings, supporting proposals, and contributing to continuous improvement of engineering practices and power quality solutions. Qualifications Strong foundation in Electrical Engineering, with applied knowledge in Electric Power systems. Experience in Power Engineering and Power Systems design, analysis, and protection for critical facilities. Knowledge of Power Generation concepts and their integration with data center and backup power solutions. Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline; advanced degrees or relevant certifications are an advantage. Familiarity with data center electrical infrastructure (UPS, generators, switchgear, PDUs, grounding, and cabling). Proficiency with electrical design and modeling tools (e.g., AutoCAD, ETAP, or similar software) and standard office applications. Understanding of applicable electrical codes, standards, and safety practices. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills, with attention to detail and system reliability. Ability to work on-site in Giza, collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary teams, and communicate technical information clearly. Previous experience in data centers, critical power, or mission-critical infrastructure is highly beneficial.

review_candidates.title: Senior Project Manager Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Opening: Senior Project Manager Engineer – Electrical Panels Company: CHINT EGEMAC Electrical Products Location: Cairo / 6th of October City, Egypt Department: Project Management & Operations Employment Type: Full-Time About CHINT EGEMAC CHINT EGEMAC is a premier joint venture combining the global technology of CHINT with the deep local manufacturing legacy of EGEMAC. We specialize in high-technology Low Voltage (LV) and Medium Voltage (MV) panel production, switchgear, Motor Control Centers (MCC), and integrated power distribution solutions for critical infrastructure across Egypt, the Middle East, and Africa. Position Overview We are seeking an experienced and driven Senior Project Manager Engineer to oversee the end-to-end execution of complex LV and MV electrical panel manufacturing projects. In this role, you will lead cross-functional teams spanning factory engineering, procurement, production, quality control, and testing to deliver custom switchboard projects on time, within scope, and aligned with IEC and ISO standards. You will serve as the main point of contact for major clients, consultants, and project stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Project Execution & Delivery: Lead project lifecycles from purchase order (PO) handover to factory acceptance testing (FAT), site delivery, and final commissioning. Engineering Alignment: Review single-line diagrams (SLDs), schematic drawings, bill of materials (BOM), and panel layout designs alongside the engineering team to ensure technical compliance with client specifications. Timeline & Resource Management: Establish master project schedules, baseline milestones, and daily tracking for sheet metal fabrication, assembly, wiring, and testing phases. Supply Chain & Procurement Coordination: Collaborate with procurement teams to track long-lead raw materials, circuit breakers, busbars, and protection relays. Client & Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary liaison for EPC contractors, end-users, and consulting engineers. Lead client progress meetings and handle change orders/variations. Risk Management & Quality Control: Identify technical and schedule bottlenecks proactively. Ensure factory production complies with ISO quality standards and project specs. Budget & Financial Oversight: Monitor project profitability, control costs against baseline budgets, and ensure timely milestone invoicing and collection. Qualifications & Requirements Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Power & Machines Engineering (or equivalent). Experience: 8+ years of experience in electrical engineering, with at least 4+ years as a Project Manager specifically focused on LV & MV switchgear, panel building, or power distribution manufacturing . Technical Expertise: Deep understanding of Low Voltage (up to 1000V) and Medium Voltage (12kV–36kV) switchgear, MCCs, distribution boards, and RMUs. Familiarity with international standards (IEC 61439, IEC 62271) and local regulations (EEHC standards). Ability to interpret complex electrical schematics, control layouts, and panel assembly specifications. Software Skills: Proficiency in MS Project or Primavera P6, AutoCAD, and ERP systems (SAP/Oracle). Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional) or equivalent certification is strongly preferred. Languages: Fluency in English and Arabic (written and spoken) is required. What We Offer Competitive compensation and performance-based bonus packages. Comprehensive social and private health insurance. Clear career progression within a joint venture. Professional exposure to megaprojects across utility, industrial, renewable, and infrastructure sectors. How to Apply Interested candidates are invited to submit their updated CV along with a cover letter referencing "Senior PM Engineer - Electrical Panels" in the subject line to recruitment@chint-egemac.com
